data.title: Context Compaction
data.tagline: Reducing current conversation history, for example by replacing older messages with a summary.
data.description: During a long website task, preserve decisions, constraints, changed files and pending work while keeping recent critical messages.
data.learningOutcome: Specify what must survive and inspect the summary. Keep original file references for exact code or rules and reread them when needed.

explanation.title: In practice
explanation.text: During a long website task, preserve decisions, constraints, changed files and pending work while keeping recent critical messages.

explanation.title: What to check
explanation.text: Specify what must survive and inspect the summary. Keep original file references for exact code or rules and reread them when needed.

data.boundary: Summaries can omit or distort details. Compaction neither enlarges the model window nor establishes durable cross-session memory.
data.agentPrompt: Compact this conversation while preserving the goal, confirmed decisions, constraints, changed files, pending work and next action. Mark uncertainty and retain source paths; do not report plans as completed work.
